fact: A Tasdjil civil-status kiosk was received at the Moundou adventist hospital on Tuesday 8 April, as part of nine kiosks planned in nine health facilities under the EU-financed Programme d'Appui à la Gouvernance 2, with ANATS.
title: Renforcement de l'état civil : l'ANATS installe des antennes dans le Tchad profond
